queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Chatbox %' AND name NOT LIKE 'Chatbox CE %' AND publisher = 'Mediocre Company';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Chatbox %' AND name NOT LIKE 'Chatbox CE %' AND publisher = 'Mediocre Company' AND version_compare(version, '1.24.7') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'chatbox.exe');
